# QUIET AMETHYST — Colour Classification Audit

**Generated by Task 1** from `grep -rnoiE` enumeration of themed files (`src/renderer/styles/theme.css`, `98.overrides.css`, and all `src/renderer/**/*.{tsx,css}`).

**Summary:** 2886 occurrences classified — palette 2303, semantic 319, honesty 3, content-intrinsic 261. Every row has a non-empty target (2886/2886).

Row count equals `wc -l /tmp/amethyst-colours.txt` (theme.css & 98.overrides.css appear twice — once as explicit grep args, once via the recursive `--include=*.css` walk — that duplication is the expected multi-source overlap, not a miscount).

## Rubric

- **palette** — chrome/surface/bevel/titlebar/accent + any TEXT colour on a surface this theme darkens → a `--ga98-*` palette/text token.
- **semantic** — role-bearing status (error red, success green, warning amber, info blue) → the fixed tier (`--ga98-status-*`).
- **honesty** — unverified / AI-unverified stamp colouring → `--ga98-unverified`.
- **content-intrinsic** — GeoINT severity/category scales, chart series, game-piece/board colours, marker/icon glyph fills, syntax highlight → `allow-list` (theme-invariant, NOT recoloured).

Per-row `target` is the deterministic suggested mapping (rule-derived from the colour value + line role); the consuming task (4–9) confirms it against the live cascade with the computed-style harness.
